supported_estimand: Paired retention-versus-mode0 benefit under matched instrumented per-cell lifecycle; RR-vs-first under same capacity/control sequence with independent boot uncertainty
unsupported_inference: Positive paired benefit alone is not net unmodified Linux deployment gain; fences/observers alter cache/lifecycle state as well as execution time
future_deployment_requirement: Separately authorize/preregister and actually execute an unmatched lifecycle baseline before deployment claim; no inferred net gain from subtraction/projection of measured syscall costs
mode14_scope: Kernel A/B policy contrast remains legitimate under identical ABI/enabled-control preparation/boundary; inspect absolute enabled WHOLE to distinguish genuine enabled-path change from off-arm movement. No primary results assessed.
